purpose: Teach: 客席/エンディング/上回っ/見逃し/ミネラル/延々と/深める/と同時に

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、文化祭の、本気で、絶対、客席、絶対、満員だったよね
lines.en: Riku — the festival hall was seriously packed, wasn't it?
lines.style: Bright, eager energy. Leans forward slightly. Fast-paced excitement, the words tumbling out. Genuine delight, not performed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。映画の、本気で、絶対、エンディング、絶対、グッときたぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. The movie ending really got to me, Sakura.
lines.style: Warm agreement, slightly vulnerable. Settles back. Quieter than her energy, thoughtful. The honesty underneath the cool exterior slipping through.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前の試験点、本気で、絶対、平均を、絶対、上回った、絶対、んだよね、リク
lines.en: Your test scores seriously beat the class average, didn't they, Riku?
lines.style: Genuine admiration, no edge. Direct eye contact quality. Saying something she means, without making a big performance of it. Steady, warm conviction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 試験の、本気で、絶対、ひっかけ問題、絶対、見逃した、絶対、ぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah, but I totally missed some trick questions on that test, Sakura.
lines.style: Self-deprecating half-laugh. Light shrug in the voice. Deflecting without fully dismissing her praise. The wry smile you can hear.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 運動会で、本気で、絶対、ミネラル、絶対、ウォーター、絶対、配られたよね、リク
lines.en: They handed out mineral water at the sports day — do you remember, Riku?
lines.style: Softer. A small memory surfacing. Noticing something ordinary that matters. Gently curious, like she's checking if he was there too.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、延々と、絶対、本、絶対、読み続けるよな、桜
lines.en: You read constantly, though — seriously, you're always with a book, aren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet observation, not a criticism. Admiration underneath. He's noticed something true about her and is sharing it carefully, almost tenderly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前と話すと、本気で、絶対、考えを、絶対、深める、絶対、ことが、絶対、できるよ、リク
lines.en: Talking with you seriously makes my thinking deeper, Riku.
lines.style: Earnest, a little vulnerable at the edges. Speaking something true that costs her to say out loud. Slow, deliberate. The words landing with weight.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: と同時に、お前、本気で、絶対、勉強、絶対、と、絶対、同時に、絶対、部活、絶対、頑張ってるよな、桜
lines.en: And at the same time, you're seriously managing both your studying and club activities, aren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Admiration with a catch of care underneath. Recognition that she's doing a lot. Not quite a question — more like he's seeing her fully and naming it. Gentle.
